name: bun
synopsis: JavaScript runtime, bundler and package manager
description:
Bun is a JavaScript and TypeScript runtime with a bundler, a test runner
and a package manager compatible with Node.js.  This package provides
the upstream prebuilt binary.

name: docker
description:
This package provides `dockerd', the Docker Engine daemon, which builds,
runs and manages containers, their images, volumes and networks.  It
also provides `docker-proxy'.

name: docker-buildx
synopsis: Docker plugin to build images with BuildKit
description:
Buildx extends `docker build' with the features of BuildKit:
multi-platform builds, multiple builders, remote caches and several
output formats.  Without it, `docker build' falls back to the legacy,
deprecated builder.

name: docker-cli
description:
This package provides the `docker' command, the client of the Docker
daemon.

name: docker-compose
description:
Compose describes an application made of several containers in a
`compose.yaml' file, then starts, stops and monitors it with a single
command.

name: opentofu
synopsis: Open source infrastructure as code tool
description:
OpenTofu is a community-driven fork of Terraform based on the MPL-2.0
licensed versions.  It lets you define, provision and manage
infrastructure as human-readable configuration files that can be
versioned, reused and shared.
